description: Standalone application-owned offline processing of one operator-supplied Oklahoma SOS business bulk package into an operation-scoped local-review release.
redirect_policy: No network requests, redirects, source discovery, purchase, or account actions are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry. Inspect the durable terminal receipt and the selected closed package before starting a new UUID operation.
checkpoint: One UUID operation owns its durable start record, temporary verified input snapshot, operation-scoped release, and terminal receipt.
idempotency: Every run creates a new UUID operation while binding the exact selection and source SHA-256; no source or national pointer is changed.
cancellation: Cooperative cancellation records CANCELLED and removes only the operation-owned snapshot and incomplete release; operator inputs are never modified.
retention_profile: Operator inputs remain under data/imports. Successful privacy-minimized operation releases and receipts remain local-review-only.
